name: MaCo
grounding_note: Native phrase-grounding heatmap with verified author numerical parity; nearest restoration to full original image. Shared Dice evaluates this heatmap, not the separately fine-tuned segmentation head.
prompt_protocol: AlphaRAD common prompt There is [disease].; MaCo retains native four negative prompts which AlphaRAD paper does not detail.
adapter_status: CPU classification and native phrase-grounding numerical parity passed

metadata.prompts: author default: one positive and four negative prompts; arithmetic text embedding mean
metadata.preprocess: author Resize(shorter=224), CenterCrop224, grayscale3, ToTensor, Normalize(.4978,.2449)
metadata.normalization: no feature normalization or added temperature
metadata.grounding_preprocess: author direct 224x224 bicubic resize (no crop), grayscale3 normalization; native 224 map nearest-resized to each original H/W, returned as list[N] of [C,H,W], full image coverage
metadata.segmentation_note: Evaluate the same native zero-shot phrase-grounding heatmap with shared Dice protocol; not the separately fine-tuned SIIM segmentation head.
metadata.grounding_score: author per-patch linear projection weighted by softmax(pos_weight_img/.02), raw dot product with text, Gaussian sigma1.5, nearest resize224
metadata.protocol_note: AlphaRAD paper common positive prompt There is [disease]. matches author default (trailing whitespace tokenizes identically). Four author native negative prompts retained; AlphaRAD does not specify these negative prompts. No prompt selection on test labels.
metadata.checkpoint_compatibility: Restore BERT pooler dense 384->768 from released checkpoint shape (source HF default is 384->384). Original first-token/Tanh pooling preserved; all projection weights loaded, no new inference parameters.

grounding_native_parity.comparison: Original Engine methods (CPU placement only), original full MaCo model with checkpoint-shaped pooler and strict checkpoint; native 224 maps nearest restored to original H/W
